claims.exact_statement: For every finite uniform address cube and every balanced Boolean branch family whose nonconstant-frequency branch Fourier matrix has rank two, there exist two independent balanced Boolean cores g,h and Boolean controllers sigma,tau such that every branch is in {+g,-g,+h,-h} and F(a,x)=sigma(a)((1+tau(a))g(x)+(1-tau(a))h(x))/2. For the separable subclass tau=b and sigma=s(c) on disjoint address blocks, H and I factor exactly. The explicit orthogonal majority-variant family has completely coincident branch Fourier supports, worst read 2^(t+1), fractional congestion one, spectral rank two, controller-root cost below three, and H(F_t)<4I(F_t) for every t>=1.
hypotheses: All cubes are finite and uniform; outputs are genuine signs.
The branch Fourier matrix is restricted to nonempty data frequencies and has exact real rank two.
The uniform constant-four corollary uses the displayed separable controllers and the explicit two majority-variant cores.
claims.first_unproved_line: Control the joint posterior/collision charge for arbitrary correlated rank-two controllers (sigma,tau), or prove a stable structural hypothesis that pays it without assuming FEI.
